title: LegalAId concept definition
description: A legal characterisation that attracts legal treatment. NOT a semantic dimension: entities, roles, events and facts describe the world and need no sign-off, whereas every concept record is a legal opinion an advocate must sign. A candidate is a concept only if it attaches a treatment, that treatment is distinct from every existing concept, and an advocate must be accountable for asserting it.

label.description: One line a non-lawyer can read.

definition.description: Defined by the TREATMENT DEMANDED, never by the thing described. If two candidates demand identical treatment they are one concept.

authority.description: Concepts are imported, not invented: the legislature has already published the enumeration. A concept with no authority is an opinion, not a concept.

requires_dimensions.description: The (thing x event x role) gate. A resolver must not fire on a noun alone; at least one dimension constraint is mandatory so that polypropylene in transport and polypropylene in packaging supply cannot resolve identically.

note.description: Why the gate matters for this concept. Reviewers need to see the reasoning, so it is a first-class field rather than a stray comment key.

attributes.description: A concept is not a flag. Attributes are the facts it carries into the rules.

detection.description: Ordered layers. The first that resolves wins, and its layer fixes the provenance. Layer D may only choose from this concept list; it may never invent a concept_id.

a_structured.description: Intake fields or existing generationControls flags read directly. Provenance: declared (a field the user answered) or derived (a flag existing code computed).

b_lexicon.description: Published enumerations matched against free text. Provenance: derived. Each entry must name where the list comes from.

c_threshold.description: Numeric or duration thresholds published in statute. Provenance: derived.

d_classifier.description: Constrained LLM classification. Provenance: inferred, therefore ADVISORY ONLY until confirmed. Must quote the span it read.

attaches.description: What changes when CONFIRMED. Every id is checked against the clause library and constraint files by tests/conceptRecords.test.mjs.

clauses_to_author.description: Clauses this concept NEEDS but which do not exist yet. Honest about cost: a concept with entries here cannot do its job until they are written.

confirmation.description: Asked only when the resolution is UNRESOLVED. One question, answerable by a non-lawyer, that changes the document.

unresolved_behaviour.description: What to do when the user cannot answer. Never silently default to the permissive reading.
